title_en: Come on, Why Do You Walk Drunk, Fima
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Пијана без ракија' is rendered literally ('drunk without rakija', likely meaning drunk on love or just carefree); that interpretation is my reading. 'Налани' as wooden clogs is my reading.

words_to_learn.en: does not suit, is not fitting

why do you walk drunk,

lines.cyr: ај што пијана шеташ Фиме мори
lines.lat: aj što pijana šetaš Fime mori
lines.en: hey, why do you walk drunk, Fima, my dear,
drunk without rakija.
Come on, it does not suit you, Fima,
it does not suit you,

to stroll the market,

to string gold coins,
